controls.title: Logical Access Security Policy
controls.description: The organization shall establish and maintain a logical access security policy that addresses user access management, authentication requirements, and segregation of duties for financial systems and applications.
assessment_objectives: Verify logical access policy covers financial systems

controls.title: User Access Provisioning
controls.description: Formal procedures shall exist for granting, modifying, and revoking access to financial applications and data. Access shall be authorized by appropriate management and granted based on job responsibilities and the principle of least privilege.
assessment_objectives: Verify access provisioning procedures for financial systems

controls.title: User Access Review
controls.description: Periodic reviews of user access rights to financial systems shall be performed to ensure continued appropriateness. Reviews shall be performed at least quarterly for privileged access and semi-annually for general access.
assessment_objectives: Verify periodic user access reviews are conducted

controls.title: Authentication Controls
controls.description: Authentication mechanisms shall enforce password complexity, account lockout, and session management requirements for access to financial systems. Multi-factor authentication shall be required for remote access and privileged accounts.
assessment_objectives: Verify authentication controls for financial systems

controls.title: Segregation of Duties
controls.description: Conflicting duties within financial applications shall be identified and segregated to prevent any single individual from having the ability to both initiate and approve transactions, or to modify data and suppress audit trails.
assessment_objectives: Verify segregation of duties in financial applications

controls.title: Privileged Access Management
controls.description: Access to powerful system utilities, database administration tools, and operating system accounts that can affect financial data integrity shall be restricted to authorized personnel and monitored.
assessment_objectives: Verify privileged access is restricted and monitored

controls.title: Change Management Policy
controls.description: A formal change management policy shall govern all changes to applications, databases, operating systems, and infrastructure that support financial reporting. The policy shall define roles, approval requirements, testing standards, and emergency change procedures.
assessment_objectives: Verify change management policy exists for financial systems

controls.title: Change Authorization and Testing
controls.description: All changes to financial systems shall be formally authorized, tested in a non-production environment, and approved before implementation in production. Test results shall be documented and retained.
assessment_objectives: Verify changes are authorized, tested, and approved

controls.title: Segregation of Development and Production
controls.description: Development, testing, and production environments shall be logically or physically separated. Developers shall not have the ability to promote changes directly to production without independent approval and migration by operations personnel.
assessment_objectives: Verify environment separation and migration controls

controls.title: Emergency Changes
controls.description: Emergency changes to production financial systems shall be documented after the fact with appropriate justification and retrospective approval. Emergency changes shall be reviewed and formally authorized within a defined timeframe.
assessment_objectives: Verify emergency change procedures and retrospective approvals

controls.title: Backup and Recovery
controls.description: Regular backups of financial data and system configurations shall be performed, tested, and stored securely. Recovery procedures shall be documented and periodically tested to ensure data can be restored within acceptable timeframes.
assessment_objectives: Verify backup and recovery procedures for financial systems

controls.title: Job Scheduling and Monitoring
controls.description: Batch processing and scheduled jobs affecting financial data shall be monitored for successful completion. Failures shall be detected, reported, and resolved in a timely manner with appropriate documentation.
assessment_objectives: Verify batch job monitoring and exception handling

controls.title: Incident Management
controls.description: Incidents affecting financial systems and data integrity shall be detected, reported, tracked, and resolved. Root cause analysis shall be performed for significant incidents and corrective actions implemented.
assessment_objectives: Verify incident management for financial systems

controls.title: Physical and Environmental Security
controls.description: Physical access to data centers and computing facilities housing financial systems shall be restricted to authorized personnel. Environmental controls including fire suppression, temperature control, and power protection shall be maintained.
assessment_objectives: Verify physical and environmental security of financial system infrastructure

controls.title: System Development Lifecycle
controls.description: A formal systems development lifecycle methodology shall be followed for new financial applications and major enhancements, including requirements definition, design, development, testing, user acceptance, and implementation phases with appropriate documentation and approvals.
assessment_objectives: Verify SDLC methodology for financial applications

controls.title: Data Conversion Controls
controls.description: Data conversion and migration activities for financial systems shall include validation procedures to ensure completeness and accuracy of converted data. Reconciliation between source and target systems shall be performed and documented.
assessment_objectives: Verify data conversion controls and reconciliation

controls.title: Audit Trail and Logging
controls.description: Audit logging shall be enabled on financial systems to record user activities, data modifications, and security events. Logs shall be protected from tampering and retained for a period sufficient to support audit requirements.
assessment_objectives: Verify audit logging on financial systems
